analyst.summary: Awfis is growing its flexible-workspace business quickly, adding new centres and filling them at healthy occupancy levels, and management expects that fast growth to continue. However, profit has been inconsistent even as revenue grows steadily, reflecting the upfront costs of expanding quickly, and the balance sheet carries a meaningful amount of lease-related debt. We would want to see profit growth become more consistent alongside the strong revenue growth before treating this as an attractive holding.
